name: netviz
description: Diagnostics, completion, hover, go-to-definition, rename and formatting for netviz inventory YAML.

netviz.server.path.markdownDescription: The `netviz` executable. Set this to an absolute path when netviz is in a virtual environment VS Code does not activate.

netviz.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the executable. `--no-watch` turns off netviz's own folder watching; `--log FILE` records what the server did.

netviz.server.enable.description: Run the netviz language server for YAML files.
